title: Passwords
about: Your logins and secure notes, encrypted on this device with your master password. The server keeps only ciphertext: neither it nor the AI can read them.

setup.title: Create your vault
setup.hint: Choose a master password: it opens the vault and never leaves this device. It cannot be reset — if you forget it, only the recovery key opens the vault.
setup.weakMaster: Make it stronger: a long phrase of several words is easy to remember
setup.creating: Creating… (a few seconds: the key is derived slowly on purpose)

recovery.title: Your recovery key
recovery.hint: It opens the vault if you forget the master password. It is shown only now: save it in a safe place, outside this computer (print it, write it down). Anyone with it and your account can open the vault.
recovery.saved: I have saved the recovery key

unlock.title: The vault is locked
unlock.forgot: Forgot it? Use the recovery key
unlock.recover: Open and set the new password

list.empty: The vault is empty. Add a login or a secure note.
list.confirmDelete: Delete «{{title}}»? It stays in the trash for 30 days.
list.autoLock: Locks itself after 10 minutes without use.

change.title: Change the master password
change.hint: The items stay as they are; the recovery key keeps working.
